verdict.rationale: Document AI is an API-first service with documented request parameters, official Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a /v1/batch endpoint, so it can be driven programmatically without a UI. A community user confirmed that API submission worked where the chat UI stalled, though a 900-page job timed out and had to be split into chunks. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or examples, an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and documented handling of large-job timeouts.
